tools.Name: Claude Plugins
tools.Description: A marketplace for community-contributed and official plugins that extend the functionality of Claude Cowork and Claude Code.
tools.Use_Case: Discovering, installing, and managing third-party plugins to expand agentic capabilities.

tools.Name: AI Job Search
tools.Description: A framework built on Claude Code that automates job applications, including scraping, fit evaluation, CV tailoring, and interview preparation.
tools.Use_Case: Streamlining the entire job search process from finding matches to preparing interview materials.

tools.Name: book-to-skill
tools.Description: A tool that converts technical books and documentation into structured, on-demand skills for coding agents, minimizing token usage.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling agents to query specific sections of large technical manuals or internal docs without manual searching or hallucination.
